description:
Set what apps in an iOS Simulator hear as microphone input: an audio file, a tone, or the real microphone.
A file starts playing on this call, so call it right before the action that makes the app record.

bundleId.description: App under test; the result then reports `appReady`.

plays.description: source=file only. Times the file plays. Default 1. Minimum: 1.

source.description: `file` plays `path`, `tone` a sine wave, `microphone` restores the real microphone.
